title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
english: President Donald Trump confirmed that the United States relocated its bomber fleet from RAF Fairford in the UK due to specific security threats. While officials have not provided exact details, reports suggest the decision followed concerns about potential sabotage or targeted strikes near the airbase. The US military took these risks seriously and opted to move the aircraft to avoid leaving them vulnerable.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በዩኬ የሚገኘውን የቦምብ ጣይ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያዋን RAF Fairford የለቀቀችው በደህንነት ስጋቶች ምክንያት መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። ምንም እንኳን ስለ ስጋቱ ዝርዝር መረጃ ባይሰጥም፣ ውሳኔው የመሰረተ ልማት ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል እንደተወሰደ ይታመናል። የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አመራሮች እነዚህን ስጋቶች በጣም በቁም ነገር በመመልከት አውሮፕላኖቹን ወደ ደህና ቦታ ማዛወራቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaanald Traamp akka jedhanitti, biyyi isaanii xiyyaarota boombii fe'an buufata RAF Feerfoordi irraa kan kaaste soda nageenyaa mudatee tureefidha. Odeeffannoon bal'aan baatus, tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yaada saboota alaa fi miidhaa buufaticharra gahuu danda'u ittisuufi. Humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa sodaa kana baay'ee xiinxaluun xiyyaarota isaanii iddoo nagaa qabuutti jijjiiruuf murteessaniiru.

title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election
english: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has called for an early election on November 29 following a major legislative setback regarding housing policy. His government is currently facing significant political pressure due to corruption scandals, investigations into his family, and a difficult migration crisis. By focusing his campaign on the housing crisis, Sánchez hopes to shift public attention away from these controversies and secure a stronger majority for his left-wing coalition.
amharic: የስፔኑ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝ በቤት አቅርቦት ፖሊሲ ላይ የገጠማቸውን የፓርላማ ሽንፈት ተከትሎ ህዳር 29 ቀን አስቀድሞ ምርጫ እንዲካሄድ ወስነዋል። መንግስታቸው በሙስና ቅሌቶች፣ በቤተሰባቸው ላይ በሚሰነዘሩ ክሶች እና በስደተኞች ቀውስ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ይገኛል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ በቤት አቅርቦት ችግር ላይ ትኩረት በማድረግ የህዝብን ትኩረት ከነዚህ አወዛጋቢ ጉዳዮች ለማዞር እና ለግራ ዘመም ጥምረታቸው ጠንካራ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት እየሞከሩ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Ispeen Pedro Saancheez dhimma mana jireenyaa irratti injifannoo dhabuu isaa hordofee, filannoo ariifachiisaa Sadaasa 29 akka geggeeffamu murteesseera. Mootummaan isaa shakkii malaammaltummaa, himata miseensota maatii isaa irratti dhiyaate fi rakkoo baqattootaa irratti xiyyeeffannoo guddaan irratti waan jiruuf dhiibbaa cimaa keessa jira. Saancheez xiyyeeffannoo isaa dhimma mana jireenyaa irratti taasisuun, xiyyeeffannoo ummataa rakkoolee kana irraa jijjiiruuf fi deeggarsa gaaffii isaa caalaatti argachuuf yaala jira.

title: ‘Smash the patriarchy’: Activists graffiti Cornell hall over gang rape case
english: Protesters at Cornell University vandalized an administrative building to demand justice following a 2024 gang rape case involving a campus fraternity. Activists are calling for systemic reforms, the end of Greek life, and stricter punishment for sexual assault, accusing the university of failing to protect survivors. While school officials have condemned the property damage, the ongoing legal battle continues to ignite national discussions about sexual violence on American college campuses.
amharic: የኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪዎች በ2024 በአንድ የተማሪዎች ማህበር ውስጥ ተፈጽሟል በተባለ አስገድዶ መድፈር ወንጀል ዙሪያ ፍትህን በመጠየቅ የአስተዳደር ህንፃ ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። አክቲቪስቶች ዩኒቨርሲቲው ለተጎጂዎች ጥበቃ አላደረገም በማለት የተማሪዎች ማህበራት እንዲታገዱ እና ለጾታዊ ጥቃት ፈጻሚዎች ጠንከር ያለ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ እየጠየቁ ነው። የዩኒቨርሲቲው አስተዳደር ንብረት ማውደም ተገቢ አይደለም ቢልም፣ ጉዳዩ በአሜሪካ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ውስጥ እየተከሰተ ስላለው የጾታዊ ጥቃት ችግር አገራዊ ውይይት ቀስቅሷል።
oromo: Barattoonni Yuunivarsitii Cornell, bara 2024 gareedhaan nama gudeeduun raawwatame jedhamee shakkamu irratti hiriira mormii guddaa dhageessisaniiru. Hiriirtonni kun yuunivarsitiin kun miidhamtootaaf ittisa gahaa hin taasisne jechuun, waldaaleen barattootaa (fraternities) akka cufamaniifi fudhattoonni yakka kanaa irratti tarkaanfiin cimaan akka fudhatamu gaafataniiru. Bulchiinsi yuunivarsitichaa miidhaa qabeenyaa irratti gahe balaaleffatus, dhimmi kun gudeeddii dhaabbilee barnoota ol-aanoo keessatti raawwatamu irratti falmii biyyoolessaa uumeera.

title: Super-subs help France demolish Belgium with late flurry
english: France secured a convincing 4-1 victory against Belgium in their Nations League match after trailing for much of the game. Substitutes Desire Doue, Rayan Cherki, and Michael Olise changed the momentum by scoring four goals in the final 15 minutes. This win keeps France at the top of their group, ahead of Italy and Belgium.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ በኔሽንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ቤልጂየምን 4 ለ 1 በሆነ ውጤት በማሸነፍ ወሳኝ ድል አስመዝግባለች። ጨዋታው በቤልጂየም መሪነት ቢቀጥልም፣ ተቀይረው የገቡት ተጫዋቾች ዴዚሬ ዱዌ፣ ረያን ሸርኪ እና ሚካኤል ኦሊሴ በመጨረሻዎቹ 15 ደቂቃዎች ውስጥ አራት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር የጨዋታውን ውጤት ቀይረውታል። በዚህ ውጤትም ፈረንሳይ ከጣሊያን እና ከቤልጂየም በመቅደም የምድቧን የደረጃ ሰንጠረዥ በበላይነት እየመራች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Faransaay tapha 'Nations League' irratti Beeljiyeemii wajjin taphatteen 4 fi 1 injifachuun galata guddaa galteetti. Beeljiyeem durfamtee kan turte yoo ta'u, taphattoonni bakka bu'anii galan kanneen akka Deziiree Duwee, Raayaan Sherkii fi Miikaa'eel Oliisee daqiiqaa 15n dhumaa keessatti goolii afran galchuun qabxii taphichaa jijjiiranii jiru. Injifannoo kanaanis Faransaay, Xaaliyaanii fi Beeljiyeemii dursuun sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti argamti.

title: Brazil’s presidential race head for a tough runoff
english: Brazil is preparing for a highly competitive presidential runoff election following a first round that showed significant strength for the right-wing movement. Despite being the incumbent, President Lula da Silva faces a challenging path to secure another term. The political landscape is further complicated by a high voter turnout issue, as over 29 million citizens chose not to participate in the initial vote.
amharic: ብራዚል ከምርጫው የመጀመሪያ ዙር በኋላ ከፍተኛ ፉክክር የሚታይበት የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ ሁለተኛ ዙር ለማድረግ እየተዘጋጀች ነው። የአሁኑ ፕሬዚዳንት ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ ስልጣን ለመያዝ ከባድ ፈተና ተጋርጦባቸዋል፤ ምክንያቱም የቀኝ ዘመም እንቅስቃሴዎች በፓርላማ ከፍተኛ ድጋፍ እያገኙ ነው። ከዚህም በላይ ከ29 ሚሊዮን በላይ መራጮች በምርጫው አለመሳተፋቸው የምርጫውን ሂደት ይበልጥ አወዛጋቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Brazil filannoo duraa booda dorgommiin cimaan akka itti fufuuf qophii gochaa jirti. Preezidaant Lula da Silvaa irra deebiin filatamachuuf qormaata cimaa keessa jiru, sababni isaas gareen mirgaa (right-wing) mana maree keessatti deggarsa guddaa argataa jira. Kana malees, namoonni miliyoona 29 ol ta'an sagalee kennuu dhiisuun isaanii haala filannichaa caalaatti ulfaataa taasiseera.

title: Houthis target Riyadh airpot, declare Saudi airspace open target except for holy sites
english: Houthi forces in Yemen have launched a drone strike against King Khaled International Airport in Riyadh, marking their second attack on the facility. The group warned that Saudi airspace is now considered an active combat zone, excluding only the holy sites of Makkah and Madinah. They claim the strike was a direct retaliation for recent Saudi military actions and have advised against using the country's flight paths.
amharic: በየመን የሚንቀሳቀሱት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ በሚገኘው የንጉሥ ካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ታጣቂዎቹ የሳውዲ የአየር ክልል ለጥቃታቸው ክፍት መሆኑን አስታውቀው፣ የመካ እና የመዲና ቅዱሳን ቦታዎች ብቻ ከዚህ ውጪ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በሳውዲ በኩል ለሚወሰዱ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ምላሽ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni Huthotaa kan Yaman, buufata xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa King Khaled kan magaalaa Riyaaditti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwateera. Gareen kun, qilleensii Saudii bakkeewwan qulqulluu Makkah fi Madiinaa ala haleellaa isaaniitiif banaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Haleellaan kun tarkaanfii waraana Saudi qaqqabsiisaa jirtuuf deebii ta'uu himuun, qilleensa biyyattii fayyadamuu akka dhaaban akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: CIA report warns of civil conflict and 'collapse' in Israel: Report
english: A recent internal CIA assessment warns that Israel is facing a high risk of civil war or societal collapse due to escalating internal tensions. The report highlights deep disagreements regarding military service exemptions for ultra-Orthodox citizens and concerns about post-war economic instability and settler violence. With a critical election approaching and political coalitions fracturing, experts suggest that the country’s stability is increasingly threatened from within.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የሲአይኤ ሪፖርት በእስራኤል ውስጥ እየጨመረ በመጣው የውስጥ ውጥረት ምክንያት የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ወይም የመንግስት መፍረስ አደጋ ሊከሰት እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቋል። ሪፖርቱ በተለይ በአልትራ-ኦርቶዶክስ ዜጎች ወታደራዊ አገልግሎት ነፃ መሆን ዙሪያ ያለውን ከፍተኛ አለመግባባት እና ከጦርነቱ በኋላ የተፈጠረውን የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እንደ ዋና የችግር ምንጭ ይጠቅሳል። መጪው ምርጫ የሀገሪቱን የፖለቲካ ጥምረት የበለጠ በማተራመስ የመንግስትን መረጋጋት አደጋ ላይ ሊጥለው እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Gabaasni dhiheenya CIA baase tokko, Israa'el keessatti walitti bu'iinsa uumamaa jiruun wal qabatee balaan waraana keessoo ykn kufaatii mootummaa mudachuu akka danda'u akeekkachiiseera. Gabaasichi, gaaffii tajaajila waraanaa namoota Ultra-Orthodox irratti uumamee fi rakkoo dinagdee waraana boodaa akka sababa guguddaatti eeru. Filannoon dhiyaachaa jiru kun michummaa siyaasaa biyyattii daran laaffisuun, tasgabbii biyyattii balaaf saaxiluu akka danda'u ogeeyyoonni ni dubbatu.

title: Houthis claim Mocha still under their control
english: A Houthi official named Fuad Sinan released a video from Mocha city to dispute reports that Saudi-backed forces had captured the area. He walked through the streets to demonstrate that his group remains in control of the city. This statement directly contradicts recent claims suggesting the city had fallen to opposing fighters.
amharic: የሁቲ የውጭ ጉዳይ ምክትል አስተዳዳሪ የሆኑት ፋድ ሲናን፣ በሳዑዲ የሚደገፉ ኃይሎች የሞካ ከተማን ተቆጣጠርን በሚል ያሰራጩትን መረጃ አስተባብለዋል። በከተማዋ ጎዳናዎች ላይ በመንቀሳቀስ መቅረጻቸው በተሰማው የቪዲዮ ማስረጃ፣ ከተማዋ አሁንም በቁጥጥራቸው ስር መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የከተማዋን መያዝ በተመለከተ የተነገሩትን ዘገባዎች ውድቅ የሚያደርግ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Houthi, Fuad Sinan jedhaman, oduu humnoonni Sa'udii deeggaraman magaalaa Mocha qabataniiru jedhamu soba jechuun haalaniiru. Innis qabxii kana mirkaneessuuf, magaalaa Mocha keessa deemee suuraa fi sagalee isaa gadhiiseera. Taateen kun oduun magaalaan sun qabamte jedhame dhugaa akka hin taane ibsa.

title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan activate Mecca Pact amid war with Houthis
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have activated the Mecca Pact, a mutual defense alliance that involves the rapid deployment of foreign troops to the kingdom. This decision follows an emergency meeting in Riyadh aimed at condemning security threats against Saudi Arabia amid a new military offensive against Houthi forces. While the immediate tactical impact of this deployment remains uncertain, the move serves as a significant show of international support for the Saudi-led campaign.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን ‘የመካ ስምምነት’ የተሰኘውን የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተግባራዊ ማድረጋቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ስምምነት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎችን ለመከላከል በሚደረገው ጥረት የጋራ ወታደራዊ ድጋፍን እና የሰራዊት ስምሪትን ያካትታል። እርምጃው በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል ያለመ ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የደህንነት ትብብር የሚያጠናክር ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkii fi Paakistaan waligaltee ittisa biyyaalessaa 'Mecca Pact' jedhamu hojiirra oolchuuf murteessaniiru. Murteen kun humnoota Huutii cabsuuf jecha, waraana biyyoota lamaanii gara Saudii Arabiyaatti erguu kan dabalatuudha. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyoota sadan kana gidduutti walitti dhufeenya nageenyaa kan cimsu yoo ta'u, Saudii Arabiyaa irratti weerara geggeeffamu ittisuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Trump says Saudi, Yemeni attacks against Houthis will work out 'very well'
english: President Donald Trump expressed confidence regarding the ongoing military campaign led by Saudi Arabia and its allies against Houthi forces. When asked about the offensive, he suggested that the situation would result in a successful outcome. He remains optimistic that these coordinated attacks will prove effective in the region.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና አጋሮቿ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ እየወሰዱ ባለው ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ላይ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል። ስለ ጥቃቱ የተጠየቁት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ ጉዳዩ በጥሩ ሁኔታ እንደሚጠናቀቅ ተስፋቸውን ገልጸዋል። እነዚህ የተቀናጁ ጥቃቶች በክልሉ አወንታዊ ውጤት እንደሚያመጡም ያላቸውን አመለካከት አሳይተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp, sa'udii arabiyaa fi gargaartonni ishee loltoota Huutii irratti duula waraanaa gaggeessaa jiraniif amanannaa qaban ibsaniiru. Duula kana ilaalchisee gaaffii gaafatamaniin, haalli kun karaa gaariin akka xumuramuu danda'u dubbataniiru. Tarkaanfiiwwan waloon fudhatamaa jiran kun naannichatti bu'aa gaarii akka fidan abdii qaban ibsaniiru.

title: No10 insists UK military base RAF Fairford is safe after US withdraws bombers
english: The British government has stated that RAF Fairford remains secure following the US military's decision to relocate its bombers back to America. While reports suggest the withdrawal was a response to security threats and a recent police investigation into suspicious activity near the base, US officials describe the move as a routine operational change. UK authorities maintain full confidence in the safety measures protecting the site despite the ongoing counter-terrorism inquiries.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላኖች ከዩኬው የኤርፎርስ ቤዝ አርኤኤፍ ፌርፎርድ መውጣታቸውን ተከትሎ፣ የብሪታንያ መንግስት ቤዝ ጣቢያው ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ መሆኑን አረጋግጧል። የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላኖች መነሳት ከደህንነት ስጋቶች እና በቅርቡ በጣቢያው አቅራቢያ የተከሰተ አጠራጣሪ እንቅስቃሴ ጋር የተያያዘ እንደሆነ ቢነገርም፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ግን ይህ የተለመደ የጦር መሳሪያዎች ዝውውር መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የብሪታንያ ባለስልጣናት በበኩላቸው በጣቢያው ላይ የሚደረገው የፀረ-ሽብር ምርመራ ቢኖርም፣ የአካባቢው ደህንነት አስተማማኝ እንደሆነ ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Britaan, humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa xiyyaarota isaanii buufata RAF Fairford irraa gara biyya isaaniitti deebisuu isaanii hordofee, buufatichi nageenya isaa kan eeggate ta'uu ibseera. Buqqifamuun xiyyaarota kanaa yaaddoo nageenyaa fi qorannoo poolisiin naannichaatti adeemsise wajjin walqabata jedhamee kan dubbatamu ta'us, qondaalonni Ameerikaa sochii kana akkaataa waraanni itti xiyyaarota isaa bakka tokkoo gara bakka biraatti jijjiiruun baramaa ta'e akka ta'e ibsan. Anga'oonni Britaan, qorannoon shororkeessummaa ittisuu naannichatti adeemsifamaa jiru iyyuu, buufatichi nageenya isaa kan eeggate ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests
english: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has announced a snap general election for November 29 following parliamentary defeats regarding his proposed housing reforms. The decision follows widespread public protests sparked by rising rental costs and the eviction of elderly citizens. Sánchez hopes this early vote will help him secure a stronger parliamentary majority to effectively address the nation's housing crisis and other ongoing political challenges.
amharic: የስፔኑ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝ በሀገሪቱ የቤት ኪራይ ዋጋ ንረት እና የመኖሪያ ቤት ችግርን ለመፍታት ያቀረቡት ህግ በፓርላማ ውድቅ ከተደረገ በኋላ፣ ህዳር 29 ቀን አስቸኳይ ምርጫ እንደሚካሄድ አውጀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው ከፍተኛ የቤት ኪራይ መናርን ተከትሎ በዜጎች ላይ የሚደርሰውን የመፈናቀል ችግር በመቃወም ሀገር አቀፍ ተቃውሞዎች ከተቀሰቀሱ በኋላ ነው። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ይህንን ቀደም ብሎ የሚካሄድ ምርጫ የጠሩት፣ ለለውጥ ስራዎቻቸው የሚያስፈልገውን የፓርላማ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeeraa Ispeen Pedro Saancheez, seerri rakkoo mana jireenyaa furuuf dhiyeessan mana maree biyyattii keessatti erga didamee booda, Mudde 29 filannoon idilee akka gaggeeffamu labsaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufe, gatiin kiree mana jireenyaa dabaluu fi lammiileen dullaan mana isaanii irraa ari’amuun isaanii mormii cimaa biyyoolessaa erga kaasee booda. Mummichi ministeerichaa filannoo ariifataa kana kan waaman, deeggarsa mana maree gahaa argachuun rakkoo mana jireenyaa fi dhimmoota biroo biyyattii furuuf akka isaan dandeessisuufi.

title: Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash plane into Tel Aviv airport or building, reports say

title: Teenager's hand blown off during confrontation between France school protesters and police
english: A 15-year-old student suffered a severe hand injury during violent clashes between protesters and police outside a high school in Lens, France. While reports on the cause of the injury vary, authorities have launched an official investigation into the incident. The violence occurred as students across the country protested against school conditions and staffing issues.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ ውስጥ በሚገኝ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት አቅራቢያ በተማሪዎች እና በፖሊስ መካከል በተፈጠረ ግጭት የ15 ዓመት ታዳጊ እጁን አጥቷል። የጉዳቱ መንስኤ ምን እንደሆነ በተመለከተ የተለያዩ መረጃዎች እየወጡ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩን ለማጣራት ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ግጭት የተከሰተው በመላው ፈረንሳይ የትምህርት ቤት መሠረተ ልማት እና የሰው ኃይል እጥረትን በመቃወም በተደረገው የተማሪዎች ተቃውሞ ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Faransaatti, mana barumsaa tokko biratti barattootaa fi poolisoota gidduutti walitti buiinsa uumameen dargaggeessi umriinsaa waggaa 15 ta'e harka isaa dhabeera. Miidhaan kun kan mudate akkamitti akka ta'e ilaalchisee gabaasoonni wal faallessan jiranis, aangoonni dhimmicha qorachuuf qorannoo eegalaniiru. Walitti buiinsi kun kan uumame barattoonni biyyattii guutuu keessatti haala mana barumsaa fi dhiyeessii hojjettootaa mormuun hiriira bahanii jiran keessatti.

title: Nobel Prize awarded for revealing inner workings of the brain
english: Three scientists, Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel, have been awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for pioneering optogenetics. This revolutionary technique uses light to control brain cells, allowing researchers to map neural circuits and better understand complex behaviors, feelings, and memories. By turning specific neurons on or off, this discovery is advancing medical treatments, including efforts to restore vision in the visually impaired.
amharic: ካርል ዳይሰሮዝ፣ ፒተር ሄገማን እና ጆርጅ ናጄል የተባሉ ሳይንቲስቶች በአእምሮ ሕክምና እና ምርምር ላይ ላበረከቱት የኦፕቶጄኔቲክስ ግኝት የኖቤል ሽልማት አግኝተዋል። ይህ ዘዴ የብርሃን ቴክኖሎጂን በመጠቀም የአእምሮ ሴሎችን ለመቆጣጠር ያስችላል፣ ይህም ሳይንቲስቶች የሰውን ስሜት፣ ትውስታ እና ባህሪ በዝርዝር እንዲያጠኑ ረድቷቸዋል። ይህ ግኝት ለተለያዩ የአእምሮ ሕመሞች መፍትሄ ከመፈለግ ባሻገር፣ ዓይነ ስውራን የማየት አቅማቸውን እንዲያገግሙ የሚደረጉ ሙከራዎችን እየደገፈ ይገኛል።
oromo: Saayintistoonni sadii, Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann fi Georg Nagel, damee 'optogenetics' keessatti qorannoo hojjetaniin badhaasa Noobelii argataniiru. Teknoojiin kun ifatti fayyadamuun lubbiyyoo sammuu to'achuuf gargaaruu dhaan, akkaataa sammuun keenya yaadannoo fi miira itti uumu akka beeknu nu gargaara. Qorannoon kun sammuu keessatti harka qabaachuun dhibeewwan sammuu wal’aanuu fi namoota arguun dadhaban arguuf gargaaruu keessatti bu'aa guddaa qaba.

title: Nigeria launches rescue after military plane crashes with 32 aboard
english: A Nigerian military aircraft carrying 32 people crashed in Ondo state while flying from Benin to Lagos. Aviation authorities have located the wreckage near a naval base and have initiated search-and-rescue efforts. While the status of those on board remains uncertain, officials are working to assess the situation and provide necessary assistance.
amharic: 32 ሰዎችን ጭኖ ሲበር የነበረ የናይጄሪያ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን በኦንዶ ግዛት ተከስክሷል። የአቪዬሽን ባለስልጣናት የአውሮፕላኑን ስብርባሪ በባህር ኃይል ጣቢያ አቅራቢያ ማግኘታቸውን ተከትሎ የፍለጋ እና የማዳን ስራዎች በመካሄድ ላይ ናቸው። በአውሮፕላኑ ውስጥ የነበሩ ሰዎች ሁኔታ እስካሁን በግልፅ ያልታወቀ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ሁኔታውን ለመከታተል እና አስፈላጊውን እርዳታ ለማድረግ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Xiyyaarri waraana Niijeeriya namoota 32 fe'atee balali'aa ture naannoo Ondootti kufuun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Abbootiin taayitaa biyyattii xiyyaarichi bakka buufata waraana galaanaa biratti kufuun isaa mirkanaa'ee, amma hojiin barbaachaafi fayyisuu eegalameera. Namoota xiyyaarichaa keessa turan haalli isaanii hanga ammaatti kan hin beekamne yoo ta'u, mootummaan haalicha hordofuun gargaarsa barbaachisaa ta'e gochuuf qophiirra jira.

title: Yemeni gov’t forces aim for Sanaa, but Houthi defeat will be a challenge
english: Yemeni government forces, supported by Saudi Arabia, have launched a significant military campaign to reclaim territories held by the Houthis, including the capital city of Sanaa. The military recently made progress near the Bab al-Mandeb strait and recaptured areas like Mocha, but experts warn that internal divisions and outdated equipment make a total victory difficult. While both sides are escalating the conflict, analysts suggest that a negotiated settlement remains more likely than a decisive military defeat for either party.

Irish players had previously faced intense pressure at home to boycott the fixture due to strong public support for the Palestinian cause.

title: Latest US military strike on alleged drug boat kills four in Caribbean
english: The US military recently conducted a strike on a boat in the Caribbean suspected of drug trafficking, resulting in the deaths of four people. This operation is part of the ongoing 'Operation Southern Spear,' which has caused at least 235 deaths across 70 strikes since last year. While the US claims these actions are necessary to combat cartels, international experts have raised serious concerns that these strikes violate international law.

title: Muferihat Takes Upper House Helm
english: Muferihat Kamil has been appointed as the new Speaker of the House of Federation for a five-year term, following a transition within the Prosperity Party government. She replaces Agegnehu Teshager, while Desta Ledamo has been named the new Deputy Speaker. Muferihat brings extensive leadership experience, having previously served as a minister and as the first female Speaker of the House of Peoples' Representatives.

title: Trump unveils 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee AI policy
english: President Donald Trump has established a new task force called the 'Super Intelligence Force' to manage and regulate artificial intelligence policies in the United States. Led by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton, this group aims to ensure American dominance in the field while coordinating with various public and private sectors. The initiative follows an executive order that officially rebranded artificial intelligence as 'Super Intelligence' to reflect its importance.

title: France closes up to 500 schools Monday over student protests
english: France is closing up to 500 schools this Monday due to safety concerns following violent student protests over education quality and facility conditions. Over the past week, demonstrations have spread across several major cities, resulting in property damage and injuries to both students and staff. The government is working to restore order while investigating reports that outside activists have infiltrated the student-led movement.

title: Djokovic defeats top seed Zverev to reach China Open semifinals
english: Novak Djokovic secured a spot in the China Open semifinals after a hard-fought comeback victory against top seed Alexander Zverev. Despite losing the first set and dealing with a brief dispute over court lighting, the Serbian star maintained his composure to win the next two sets. Djokovic will now advance to face Daniil Medvedev in the next round of the tournament.

title: Middle East oil exports surpass pre-war levels despite tensions, data shows
english: Despite ongoing regional conflicts and rising tensions, Middle East crude oil exports have recovered and climbed above pre-war averages toward the end of September. While official ship-tracking data indicates a surge in volume, Iranian officials have downplayed these figures and claimed to have forced US warships away from the region. The situation remains volatile, with reports of daily maritime attacks and Iranian threats to keep key shipping channels closed.

oromo: Giddugaleessa Bahaatti waraanni fi tasgabbii dhabuun jiraatus, gurgurtaa boba'aa biyya alaa garaa hamma waraana duraa caaluun gara dhuma ji'a Fulbaanaatti dabaleera. Qondaalonni Iraan odeeffannoo kana mormuudhaan, dooniiwwan waraanaa Ameerikaa naannichaa gadhiisanii akka baqatan fi sochii boba'aa akka hir'ate dubbatu. Ta'us, weerarri dooniiwwan irratti raawwatamu fi doorsisni Iraan daandii bishaan irraa Hormuz cufuuf kennite, naannicha balaa fi tasgabbii dhabuu keessa akka jiru mirkaneessiti.

title: Who were the top teen athletes at the Asian Games?
english: Teenage athletes made a significant impact at the recent Asian Games, with young swimmers leading their countries to historic victories. Nineteen-year-old Zhang Zhanshuo from China secured an impressive seven gold medals, while 13-year-old Yu Zidi earned MVP honors by setting multiple new records. Japanese athlete Shin Ohashi also stood out by becoming the first person to swim the 200m breaststroke in under two minutes and five seconds.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የእስያ ጨዋታዎች ላይ ታዳጊ አትሌቶች አስደናቂ አፈጻጸም በማሳየት ለሀገሮቻቸው ታሪካዊ ድሎችን አስመዝግበዋል። የ19 ዓመቱ የቻይናው ዣንግ ዣንሹኦ ሰባት የወርቅ ሜዳሊያዎችን ሲያሸንፍ፣ የ13 ዓመቷ ዩ ዚዲ በተለያዩ የውድድር ዘርፎች ክብረ ወሰኖችን በመስበር የውድድሩ ምርጥ አትሌት ተብላለች። እንዲሁም የጃፓኑ ሺን ኦሃሺ የ200 ሜትር የጡት ምት ዋና ውድድርን ከሁለት ደቂቃ ከአምስት ሰከንድ በታች በማጠናቀቅ አዲስ የዓለም ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግቧል።
oromo: Atileetonni dargaggoon tapha Eeshiyaa dhihoo kana gaggeeffame irratti raawwii dinqisiisaa agarsiisuun biyyoota isaanii injifannoo seena qabeessa gonfachiisaniiru. Zhang Zhanshuo kan Chaayinaa waggaa 19 ta’e medaalii warqee torba yoo galchu, Yu Zidi waggaa 13 ta’e immoo rekoodiiwwan hedduu cabsuudhaan atileetii hunda caalu jedhamee badhaafameera. Kana malees, Shin Ohashi kan Jaappaan dorgommii daakkoo meetira 200 daqiiqaa lamaa fi sekondii shan gadiin xumuruudhaan rekoodii addunyaa haaraa galmeesseera.

title: Samoa PM apologises after Nazi salute video emerges
english: Samoa's Prime Minister, La’auli Leuatea Schmidt, has issued an apology after a 2007 video surfaced showing him performing a Nazi salute and shouting 'Heil Hitler' at a family event. The Prime Minister clarified that his past actions do not align with his current personal values or the stance of his government, firmly rejecting Nazism and extremism. Despite his strong support for Israel during his tenure, the resurfaced footage has drawn significant criticism from historians and academics.
amharic: የሳሞአው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ላኡሊ ሊዩአቴያ ሽሚት በ2007 ዓ.ም የናዚን ሰላምታ ሲሰጡ እና 'ሃይል ሂትለር' ሲሉ የሚያሳይ የቪዲዮ ምስል በመውጣቱ ይቅርታ ጠይቀዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ እነዚህ ድርጊቶች አሁን ካላቸው እምነት ወይም ከመንግስታቸው መርህ ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌላቸው በመግለጽ ናዚዝምን እና ጽንፈኝነትን በይፋ አውግዘዋል። በስልጣን ዘመናቸው ለእስራኤል ያላቸውን ጠንካራ ድጋፍ ቢገልጹም፣ የቀድሞው የቪዲዮ ምስል በታሪክ ምሁራን ዘንድ ትችት አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Samoa La’auli Leuatea Schmidt, bara 2007 walga’ii maatii irratti mallattoo Naazii agarsiisanii fi 'Heil Hitler' jechuun isaanii viidiyoon ifa bahee booda dhiifama gaafataniiru. Mummichi Ministeerichaa gochi isaan darbe kun amantii isaanii fi ilaalcha mootummaa isaanii kan bakka bu’u miti jedhanii, Naaziizmii fi ධራ ጽንፈኝነት akka balaaleffatan ibsaniiru. Yeroo aangoo isaanii keessa Israa’eliif deggarsa guddaa kan qaban ta’us, viidiyoon kun hayyoota fi seenaa qorattoota biratti qeeqameera.

title: Bolsonaro beats expectations in Brazil vote, faces Lula in runoff
english: Brazil's presidential election will head to a runoff because neither candidate secured the required majority of the vote. Both Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and incumbent Jair Bolsonaro failed to reach the 50 percent threshold needed for an immediate victory. As a result, the two frontrunners will face each other again in a final round to determine the country's next leader.
amharic: የብራዚል የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ አሸናፊ ለመለየት ሁለተኛ ዙር ድምጽ መስጠት እንደሚያስፈልግ ተገለጸ። የሀገሪቱ ወቅታዊ ፕሬዚዳንት ጃየር ቦልሶናሮ እና ተቀናቃኛቸው ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ አንዳቸውም በምርጫው ለማሸነፍ የሚያስፈልገውን 50 በመቶ ድምጽ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። በመሆኑም አሸናፊውን ለመለየት ሁለቱ እጩዎች በሚቀጥለው ዙር ይወዳደራሉ።
oromo: Filannoon pirezidaantummaa biyya Brazil kanaan dura abdachiisirraa adda ta'ee, mo'ataa sirritti adda baasuuf gara marsaa lammaffaatti ce'eera. Pirezidaantiin amma aangoorra jiran Jaayir Bolsonaro fi morkataan isaanii Luwiiz Inaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa, nama tokkoon tokkoon isaanii mo'achuuf kan barbaachisu sagalee dhibbeentaa 50 guutuu hin dandeenye. Kanaafuu, hogganaa biyyattii itti aanu murteessuuf dorgommiin marsaa xumuraa akka gaggeeffamuuf jira.

title: Tigray’s Liberation Must End in Freedom
english: Tigrayan nationalism has successfully defended the region's survival through war, but it has failed to establish a lasting, citizen-led political order. The current crisis persists because leaders prioritize factional control over building inclusive institutions that function independently of military commanders. To move forward, the region must transition from mere liberation to the difficult task of creating a stable, law-bound government.
amharic: የትግራይ ብሄርተኝነት በጦርነት አማካኝነት የክልሉን ህልውና በማስጠበቅ ረገድ ስኬታማ ቢሆንም፣ ዘላቂ እና በህዝብ የሚመራ የፖለቲካ ስርዓት መመስረት አልቻለም። አሁን ያለው ቀውስ የሚቀጥለው መሪዎች የጋራ አስተዳደር ከመገንባት ይልቅ ለቡድን የበላይነት ቅድሚያ በመስጠታቸው ነው። ክልሉ ከነጻነት አውጪነት ወደ ዘላቂ፣ በህግ የሚመራ እና የተረጋጋ የፖለቲካ ስርዓት ግንባታ መሸጋገር አለበት።

Rakkoon yeroo ammaa jiru, gaggeessitoonni sirna waloo ijaaruu mannaa aangoo ofii jabeessuuf xiyyeeffannaa waan kennaniif kan dhufe dha. Kanaafuu, naannichi bilisummaa qofa irraa gara ijaarsa sirna siyaasaa tasgabbaa'aa fi seeraan bulanitti ce'uun isa barbaachisa.

title: Four African leaders issue joint declaration as Ethiopia war escalates
english: The leaders of Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia, and Sudan recently held a summit in Egypt to address rising regional tensions, including the civil war in Sudan and renewed fighting in Ethiopia. They released a joint statement advocating for peaceful dialogue while expressing opposition to Ethiopia's unilateral actions regarding Red Sea access and the Renaissance Dam. The declaration further emphasized that control of the Red Sea should be managed by coastal nations, signaling a clear disagreement with Ethiopia’s regional policies.

oromo: Hoggantoonni Gibxii, Eertiraa, Somaaliyaa fi Sudaan walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa kanneen akka waraana Sudaanii fi guddina waraana Itoophiyaa keessatti mul’atu irratti mari’achuuf Gibxii keessatti walgahaniiru. Hoggantoonni kunneen ibsa waloo baasaniin, rakkoolee nageenyaan hiikuun akka barbaachisu kan ibsan yoo ta’u, Itoophiyaan dhimma daangaa Galaana Diimaa fi hidha guddicha irratti tarkaanfii kophaa fudhattu mormaniiru. Ibsichi to’annoon Galaana Diimaa biyyoota daangaa qaban qofa jala turuu akka qabu dhaamsa dabarsuun, imaammata Itoophiyaa waliin walitti bu’iinsa qaban ifa godhaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Yemen fighting intensifies; Tehran says ready for US attacks
english: Yemeni government forces have launched a significant military offensive aimed at reclaiming lands currently occupied by the Houthi rebels. Meanwhile, Iran's Foreign Minister stated that while a military resolution to tensions with the United States is not viable, Tehran is prepared for a potential conflict. These developments highlight the escalating instability in the region as multiple factions engage in military movements.

oromo: Mootummaan Yemen, lafa yeroo ammaa kana harka warra Huutii jiru deebifachuuf duula waraanaa guddaa jalqabuu isaa beeksiseera. Gama biraatiin, ministirri dhimma alaa Iraan rakkoo Amerikaa waliin jiru waraanaan furuun akka hin danda'amne ibsuun, garuu biyyi isaanii waraanaaf qophii ta'uu ishee mirkaneessaniiru. Gochootni kunniin walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa keessatti mul'atu daran kan hammaatee deemu ta'uu agarsiisu.

title: Israel face spitting allegation as Ireland boss ‘delighted’ ties after over
english: Following a tense UEFA Nations League match between Ireland and Israel that ended in a 1-1 draw, an Irish coach has accused an Israeli player of spitting at him. The Irish manager expressed relief that the two-game series is over, noting the significant emotional and political strain the fixtures placed on his team. Football authorities are expected to launch a disciplinary investigation into the alleged incident.

oromo: Tapha UEFA Nations League biyyoota Ayirlaandi fi Israa'el gidduutti godhamee 1-1 xumurame booda, taphataan Israa'el tokko leenjisaa Ayirlaandi irratti tufachuu isaa himatameera. Leenjisaan garee Ayirlaandi taphonni kun xumuramuu isaaniitti gammachuu ibsuun, dhiibbaa siyaasaa fi miiraa cimaa taphattootasaanii irra ture eeraniiru. Koreen angoon isaa adabbii fi qulqullinaa irratti hojjatu himata kana akka qoratu eegama.

title: Manchester City must be relegated, says Canada’s ex-Leeds manager
english: Former Leeds United manager Jesse Marsch has argued that Manchester City should face relegation due to severe financial rule violations spanning nine seasons. Marsch claims that the club's alleged manipulation of revenue and costs was an open secret within the Premier League, creating an unfair competitive landscape. While Manchester City denies these accusations and is currently appealing the ruling, Marsch insists that strict disciplinary action is necessary to maintain integrity in football.
amharic: የቀድሞው የሊድስ ዩናይትድ አሰልጣኝ ጄሲ ማርሽ ማንቸስተር ሲቲ በዘጠኝ ዓመታት የፋይናንስ ህጎችን በመጣሱ ወደ ታችኛው ሊግ መውረድ አለበት ሲሉ ተከራክረዋል። የክለቡ የገቢ እና የወጪ መረጃዎችን አዛብቶ ማቅረብ በፕሪሚየር ሊጉ ውስጥ ግልጽ ምስጢር እንደነበረ የገለጹት አሰልጣኙ፣ ይህም ፍትሃዊ ያልሆነ ውድድር እንደፈጠረ ይናገራሉ። ማንቸስተር ሲቲ የቀረቡበትን ክሶች አስተባብለው ይግባኝ ቢጠይቁም፣ ማርሽ ግን ስፖርታዊ ታማኝነትን ለመጠበቅ ጥብቅ ቅጣት መጣል እንዳለበት አጥብቀው ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Leenjisaan duraanii garee Liids Yuunayited Jeesii Maarsh, Maanchastar Siitiin seera faayinaansii liigichaa waggoota sagaliif waan cabseef gara liigii gad-aanaatti bu'uu qaba jedhaniiru. Maarsh akka jedhanitti, gareen kun galii fi baasii isaa garmalee guddisee ibsuun isaa durumaanuu namni hundi kan beeku ture, kunis dorgommii sirrii ta'e akka hin jiraanne taasiseera jedhan. Maanchastar Siitiin himannaa kana haaluun komii dhiyeessus, Maarsh garuu amanamummaa ispoortichaa eeguuf adabbiin cimaan murteessaa akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo can return to Portugal team if he wants, says Jesus
english: Portugal's head coach, Jorge Jesus, stated that Cristiano Ronaldo is welcome to return to the national team if he chooses to do so. This follows Ronaldo's sudden departure from the squad after being placed on the bench for a recent UEFA Nations League match. Jesus emphasized that the decision rests entirely with the 41-year-old star, who remains eligible for future selection.
amharic: የፖርቹጋል ብሄራዊ ቡድን አሰልጣኝ ጆርጌ ጄሱስ እንዳሉት ክርስቲያኖ ሮናልዶ መመለስ ከፈለገ ወደ ቡድኑ ለመቀላቀል በሩ ክፍት ነው። ይህ የሆነው ሮናልዶ በቅርቡ በተደረገ የዩኢኤፍኤ ኔሽንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ በቋሚ ተሰላፊነት ስላልተካተተ ከቡድኑ ለቆ መውጣቱን ተከትሎ ነው። አሰልጣኙ ውሳኔው ሙሉ በሙሉ በራሱ በሮናልዶ እጅ ላይ መሆኑንና ለቀጣይ ጨዋታዎችም በቡድኑ ውስጥ የመካተት እድል እንዳለው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Leenjisaan garee biyyaalessaa Poorchugaal Joorjee Jeesus akka jedhanitti, Kirstiyaanoo Roonaldon yoo fedhe gara garee biyyaalessaa isaa deebi'uu danda'a. Kun kan ta'e erga Roonaldon tapha 'UEFA Nations League' darbe irratti baankiirra taa'uun isaa erga isa aarse booda garee isaa gadhiisee deemuusaa hordofee dha. Leenjisaan kun murtoon kun guutummaatti kan Roonaldotti akka jiruufi gara fuulduraattis garee keessatti hammatamuuf carraan akka jiru ibsaniiru.

title: Election panel orders Netanyahu to remove 'election propaganda' videos
english: Israel's election oversight committee has commanded Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to delete online videos that improperly utilized state and military resources for political gain. The committee ruled that these clips functioned as campaign propaganda designed to influence voters by highlighting government accomplishments. Additionally, Netanyahu was fined approximately $9,500 to cover the legal costs incurred by those who challenged the videos.
amharic: የእስራኤል የምርጫ ኮሚቴ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የመንግስት እና የወታደራዊ ሀብቶችን ያለአግባብ ለፖለቲካ ቅስቀሳ የተጠቀሙባቸውን ቪዲዮዎች እንዲያስወግዱ ትዕዛዝ አስተላልፏል። ኮሚቴው እነዚህ ቪዲዮዎች መራጮችን ለመሳብ የተዘጋጁ የምርጫ ቅስቀሳዎች እንደሆኑ ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ለከሳሾቹ ወደ 9,500 የአሜሪካ ዶላር የሚጠጋ የህግ ወጪ እንዲከፍሉ ተወስኖባቸዋል።
oromo: Komishiniin filannoo Israa'el, Ministirri Muummee Beniyaamin Netaaniyaahuu qabeenya mootummaa fi waraanaa seeraan alaa fiixa baasuuf itti fayyadaman jedhamanii kanneen shakkaman viidiyoowwan intarneetii irraa akka haqu ajajeera. Komishinichi viidiyoowwan kunneen yaadannoo mootummaan hojjete ibsuun sagalee namaa argachuuf kan qophaa'an duula filannoo akka ta'an murteesseera. Kana malees, Netaaniyaahuun baasii seeraa kanneen isa himatanif gara doolaara Ameerikaa 9,500 kaffaluuf akka dirqaman murtaa'eera.

title: Israeli troops kill man in southern Syria
english: Israeli forces shot and killed a man in southern Syria early Monday, claiming he was attempting to approach a military site. This incident is part of ongoing Israeli operations in the region following the collapse of the Assad regime in late 2024. Israel maintains that these actions are necessary to ensure the safety of its troops and citizens.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ሰኞ ዕለት በደቡብ ሶሪያ አንድ ግለሰብ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ለመግባት ሞክሯል በሚል ተኩስ ከፍተው ገድለውታል። ይህ ድርጊት የአሳድ መንግስት በ2024 መጨረሻ ከወደቀ በኋላ በእስራኤል እየተካሄደ ካለው ቀጣይ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ አንዱ ነው። እስራኤል እነዚህን እርምጃዎች የወሰደችው የዜጎቿን እና የሠራዊቷን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እንደሆነ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el ganamuma Dilbataatti gara kibba Suuriyaatti namicha tokko bakka buufata waraanaa isaanii seenuuf yaalera jedhee ajjeeseera. Gochi kun mootummaan Assaad bara 2024 xumura irratti erga kufee booda tarkaanfiiwwan Israa'el naannichatti fudhatamaa jiran keessaa tokko dha. Israa'el tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte nageenya loltootaa fi lammiilee ishee eeguuf akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: Watch: Saudi air strike hits foam factory in Yemen’s Sanaa
english: A Saudi-led airstrike recently targeted a foam manufacturing facility located in Sanaa, the capital of Yemen currently controlled by Houthi forces. The attack resulted in a large fire at the site as residents and workers attempted to control the blaze. Yemen's government, which is supported by Saudi Arabia, confirmed conducting military operations against various Houthi positions throughout the country on Sunday.
amharic: በየመን ዋና ከተማ ሰንዓ፣ በሁቲ አማፂያን ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው የፎም ፋብሪካ ላይ በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የሚመራ የአየር ጥቃት ተፈጽሟል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ ፋብሪካው ተቀጣጥሎ በነበረው እሳት በመጋየቱ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እሳቱን ለማጥፋት ጥረት አድርገዋል። በሳዑዲ የሚደገፈው የየመን መንግሥት በበኩሉ፣ እሁድ ዕለት በተለያዩ የሀገሪቱ ክፍሎች በሁቲ ኢላማዎች ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ መውሰዱን አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Magaalaa guddittii Yaman, Sana'aa keessatti bakka Houthii to’annoo isaa jala jiru, warshaalee foomii irratti weerarri qilleensaa kan Saudii Arabaan durfamu raawwatameera. Weerara kanaan booda warshicha keessatti ibidda ka’een namoonni ibidda dhaamsuuf carraaqqii gochaa turan. Mootummaan Yaman kan Saudii Arabaan gargaaramu, guyyaa Dilbata darbe bakkeewwan Houthiin itti argaman irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuu isaa mirkaneesseera.

title: Polls close in Brazil as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remain neck and neck
english: Voting has concluded in Brazil's highly competitive presidential election, which features a close contest between incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. With over 150 million citizens eligible to participate, officials expect the electronic results to be processed and released quickly. If neither candidate secures an outright majority of more than 50%, a second round of voting will take place on October 25.
amharic: የብራዚል አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ድምፅ አሰጣጥ መጠናቀቁን ተከትሎ ወቅታዊው ፕሬዝዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና ተፎካካሪያቸው ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ እጅግ አጠራጣሪ እና የጠበበ ፉክክር እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። ከ150 ሚሊዮን በላይ ብራዚላውያን ድምፅ የመስጠት መብት ያላቸው ሲሆን፣ የኤሌክትሮኒክስ ድምፅ አሰጣጥ ስርዓቱ ውጤቱን በፍጥነት እንደሚያሳውቅ ይጠበቃል። ማንኛውም እጩ ከ50 በመቶ በላይ ድምፅ ማግኘት ካልቻለ፣ የሁለተኛ ዙር ምርጫ ጥቅምት 25 ቀን ይካሄዳል።
oromo: Filannoon biyya Brazil kan hanga ammaa itti fufaa ture xumurameera; kunis kan agarsiisu pirezidaantii amma aangoorra jiran Lula da Silva fi morkataa isaanii Flávio Bolsonaro gidduutti dorgommii cimaa jiraachuu dha. Namoonni miiliyoona 150 ol ta'an sagalee kennuuf mirga kan qaban yoo ta'u, bu'aan sagalee elektirooniksii battalumatti akka beekamu eegama. Yoo namni tokko sagalee kenne keessaa harka 50 ol argachuu baate, filannoon lammaffaan Onkololeessa 25tti kan geggeeffamu ta'a.

title: Cornell case puts New York’s progressive image at odds with its rape laws
english: A lawsuit filed by a Cornell University student alleging gang rape has sparked a major push to reform sexual assault laws in New York. Critics argue that despite the state's progressive reputation, legal loopholes like the 'voluntary intoxication' rule hinder survivors from getting justice. In response, New York officials have created a working group to review these statutes and propose changes during the upcoming legislative session.
amharic: በኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪ በቡድን ተደፈርኩ በሚል የቀረበው ክስ በኒውዮርክ የፆታ ጥቃት ህጎች ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ እንዲደረግ ግፊት ፈጥሯል። የኒውዮርክ ግዛት በሴቶች መብት ረገድ ግንባር ቀደም ነኝ ብትልም፣ አሁን ያሉት ህጎች ለተጎጂዎች ፍትህ ለማግኘት እንቅፋት እየሆኑ መሆኑ ይነገራል። ለዚህም ምላሽ ለመስጠት የኒውዮርክ ባለስልጣናት ነባር የፆታ ጥቃት ህጎችን ለመከለስ እና ማሻሻያ ለማቅረብ የስራ ቡድን አቋቁመዋል።
oromo: Barataan Yuunivarsitii Cornell tokko himata gudeeddii gareen raawwatame jedhee dhiyeesseen walqabatee, seeronni yakka saal-qunnamtii fiizii biyya New York akka fooyya'an dhiibbaan cimaan uumameera. Mootummaan New York mirga dubartootaatiin beekkamus, seeronni yeroo ammaa jiran namoota miidhaan irra gaheef mirga isaanii mirkaneessuuf rakkoo akka ta'an dubbatamaa jira. Haala kanaan, aanga'oonni New York seeronni kun akka sakatta'aman fi fooyya'iinsi barbaachisu akka godhamuuf garee hojii hundeessaniiru.

title: Ireland refuse handshake with Israel and don armbands in Nations League tie
english: During their UEFA Nations League match, the Republic of Ireland football team wore black armbands to honor Palestinians killed in Gaza. The Irish captain continued the team's protest by refusing to shake hands with the Israeli captain before kickoff. This match, which ended in a 1-1 draw, was moved to a neutral venue in Serbia due to public pressure regarding the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የአየርላንድ ብሄራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን በዩኤፋ ኔሽንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ወቅት በጋዛ ለተገደሉ ፍልስጤማውያን መታሰቢያ እንዲሆን ጥቁር ማሰሪያዎችን ለብሰዋል። የቡድኑ አምበል ከእስራኤል አቻው ጋር እጅ ከመጨባበጥ በመታቀብ ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። በሰርቢያ ገለልተኛ ሜዳ የተካሄደውና 1 ለ 1 በሆነ ውጤት የተጠናቀቀው ይህ ጨዋታ፣ ከእስራኤል-ፍልስጤም ግጭት ጋር በተያያዘ በህዝብ ግፊት ምክንያት ከዳብሊን ወደ ሌላ ቦታ እንዲዛወር ተደርጓል።
oromo: Taphattoota kubbaa miilaa biyya Ayirland tapha UEFA Nations League irratti, namoota Gaazaatti ajjeefamaniif yaadannoo ta'uuf harka isaanii irratti marsaa gurraacha hidhataniiru. Kabajni garee Ayirland durfataan isaa dura taa'aa garee Israa'el waliin harka wal qabachuu diduun mormii isaa ibseera. Taphi kun kan gaggeeffame biyya Serbiya keessatti bakka walaba ta'etti yoo ta'u, mormii waraana waldhabdee Israa'el fi Falasxiin irratti jiruun kan ka'e, taphichi magaalaa Dabliin keessaa gara iddoo biraatti akka jijjiiramu taasifameera.

title: Ronaldo-less Portugal beat Norway 2-1 to reach Nations League quarterfinals
english: Portugal secured a spot in the UEFA Nations League quarterfinals after defeating Norway 2-1, even without Cristiano Ronaldo in the lineup. Despite finishing the match with ten men following Francisco Conceicao’s red card, the team maintained their perfect record in the group stage. Goals from Joao Cancelo and Goncalo Ramos were enough to overcome Norway’s early lead and confirm Portugal's place in the next round.
amharic: ክርስቲያኖ ሮናልዶ በሌለበት ጨዋታ ፖርቹጋል ኖርዌይን 2-1 በማሸነፍ ወደ ዩኢኤፍኤ (UEFA) ኔሽንስ ሊግ የሩብ ፍጻሜ ማለፏን አረጋግጣለች። ፍራንሲስኮ ኮንሴሳዎ በቀይ ካርድ ከሜዳ ቢሰናበትም፣ ፖርቹጋል በቡድን ደረጃ የነበራትን ድል አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች። የጆአዎ ካንሴሎ እና ጎንካሎ ራሞስ ግቦች የኖርዌይን ቀዳሚ ግብ በመቀልበስ ቡድኑ ለቀጣዩ የውድድር ምዕራፍ እንዲያልፍ አስችለውታል።
oromo: Portugal, taphataa Cristiano Ronaldo malee, Norway 2-1 mo'achuudhaan gara hamma xumuraa (quarter-final) UEFA Nations League dabarteetti. Francisco Conceicao kaardii diimaa argatee yoo bahus, gareen Portugal qabxii guutuu fi injifannoo walitti aansuudhaan sadarkaa garee isaanii irratti milkaa'aniiru. Galchiiwwan Joao Cancelo fi Goncalo Ramos garee Norway dursanii turan kan of duuba deebisan yoo ta'u, kunis Portugal gara hamma itti aanuutti akka dabartu taasiseera.

title: Israel lashes out as UK’s Green Party formally defines Zionism as ‘racism’
english: The UK's Green Party has sparked outrage by officially classifying Zionism as a form of racism and labeling it an ethnonationalist project. The party further demanded an immediate end to British arms sales to Israel and expressed support for a single democratic state in the region. In response, Israeli officials and Jewish organizations condemned the resolution, arguing that it promotes antisemitism and provides legitimacy to terrorism.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ አረንጓዴ ፓርቲ (Green Party) ጽዮናዊነትን የዘረኝነት መገለጫ አድርጎ በመፈረጁ ከፍተኛ ቁጣን አስነስቷል። ፓርቲው ብሪታኒያ ለእስራኤል የምታደርገውን የጦር መሳሪያ ሽያጭ በአስቸኳይ እንድታቆም የጠየቀ ሲሆን በታሪካዊቷ ፍልስጤም ምድር አንድ ዴሞክራሲያዊ መንግስት እንዲመሰረትም ድጋፉን ገልጿል። የእስራኤል መንግስት እና አንዳንድ የብሪታኒያ የአይሁድ ማህበረሰቦች ይህ ውሳኔ ፀረ-ሴማዊነትን የሚያበረታታ እና ሽብርተኝነትን የሚያግዝ ነው በማለት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ አውግዘውታል።
oromo: Paartiin Magariisa (Green Party) kan biyya Ingiliiz, Zihiyoonizimii akka gosa tokkootti akka sanyii loogii ibsuun isaa mormii cimaa kaaseera. Paartiin kun gurgurtaa meeshaa waraanaa Ingiliiz gara Israa'elitti ergitu hatattamaan akka dhaabdu kan gaafate yoo ta'u, biyya tokkoo fi dimookraatawaa ta'e lafa Falasxiin keessatti akka hundaa'u deggersa isaa ibseera. Mootummaan Israa'el fi gareewwan Ayihudoota Ingiliiz murtee kana akka yaada jibbinsa Ayihudootaa (antisemitism) babal'isuu fi shororkeessummaa deggerutti ilaaludhaan balaaleffataniiru.

title: Debris found near Nantucket believed to be from missing medical plane
english: The US Coast Guard has located debris near Nantucket, Massachusetts, which is suspected to belong to a medical aircraft that disappeared over the Atlantic. The plane went missing on Saturday night with six individuals on board. Authorities are currently investigating the site as part of search and rescue efforts.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የባህር ጠረፍ ጠባቂዎች ከናንቱኬት፣ ማሳቹሴትስ አቅራቢያ ከአትላንቲክ ውቅያኖስ ላይ የጠፋ የህክምና አውሮፕላን ሊሆን ይችላል የተባለ ፍርስራሽ አግኝተዋል። አውሮፕላኑ ስድስት ሰዎችን ጭኖ ቅዳሜ ምሽት ላይ ነበር የጠፋው። ባለሥልጣናቱ በአሁኑ ጊዜ በፍለጋ እና በነፍስ አድን ስራዎች ላይ ተሰማርተው ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Eegumsi Qarqara Galaana Yunaayitid Isteetes naannoo Nantucket, Maasaachuseetsitti, xiyyaara fayyaa kan galaana Atilaantiki irraa badee ture kan ta'e shtaa (caccabaa) argachuu isaa beeksiseera. Xiyyaarichi namoota ja'a fe'ee Dilbata dura galgala bade ture. Abbootiin taayitaa ammatti hojii barbaachaafi lubbuu baraaruu irratti xiyyeeffatanii qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: No military solution to US-Iran war, Iranian foreign minister says
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that military action and sanctions will not resolve the ongoing conflict between Iran and the United States. He emphasized that the only path to peace is through fair and just negotiations. However, he warned that Iran will respond with increased force if the U.S. attempts to initiate a military confrontation.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው ውዝግብ በጦርነትም ሆነ በኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ መፍትሄ እንደማያገኝ ገለጹ። ግጭቱን ለመፍታት ብቸኛው አማራጭ ፍትሃዊ በሆነ ድርድር መሄድ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ነገር ግን አሜሪካ በወታደራዊ መንገድ ብትመጣ ኢራን ከበፊቱ በበለጠ ኃይል ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆኗን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Iraan Abbas Araghchii, walitti bu’iinsa biyyattii fi Amerikaa gidduu jiru furuuf waraanis ta’e uggurri diinagdee bu’aa akka hin qabne ibsan. Rakkoo kana hiikuuf karaa furmaataa inni tokkichi marii haqa qabeessa ta’e qofa akka ta’e hubachiisaniiru. Haa ta’u malee, Amerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuu yoo yaalte, Iraan of ittisuuf humnatti fayyadamuun deebii cimaa kan kennitu ta’uu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Lebanon seeks 'new chapter' with Iran, prime minister says
english: Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam has expressed a desire to improve relations with Iran by prioritizing mutual respect and avoiding interference in domestic affairs. He indicated that Lebanon is moving away from waiting for international deals, such as those between the U.S. and Iran, and instead focusing on its own state responsibilities. Furthermore, Lebanon continues to urge an immediate end to Israeli attacks and demands a complete withdrawal of Israeli forces from its territory.
amharic: የሊባኖሱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናዋብ ሳላም ከኢራን ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት በመከባበር እና በውስጥ ጉዳይ ጣልቃ አለመግባት መርህ ላይ በመመስረት ማሻሻል እንደሚፈልጉ ገልጸዋል። ሊባኖስ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል የሚደረግ ስምምነትን ከመጠበቅ ይልቅ የራሷን የሀገር ውስጥ ኃላፊነቶች ለመወጣት እንደምትሰራም አስታውቀዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ሀገሪቱ የእስራኤል ጥቃቶች እንዲቆሙ እና የእስራኤል ኃይሎች ከሊባኖስ ምድር ለቀው እንዲወጡ ግፊት ማድረጓን ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Libaanoos Nawaf Salaam, hariiroo biyyattii fi Iraan gidduu jiru kabaja waloo fi dhimma keessoo keessatti gidduu galuu dhabuu irratti hundaa'uun fooyyessuuf fedhii akka qaban ibsaniiru. Libaanoos walii galtee Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti godhamu eeggachuu mannaa, itti gaafatamummaa mataa ishee bahuuf murteessiteetti. Kana malees, Libaanoos weerarri Israa'el battalumatti akka dhaabatuu fi waraanni Israa'el biyyattii keessaa akka ba'u gaafachuushee itti fufteetti.

title: Israel slams Green Party after members vote to define Zionism as racism
english: The Green Party of England and Wales has faced harsh criticism from Israeli officials after voting to officially label Zionism as racism. This new policy also rejects the traditional two-state solution in favor of creating a single democratic state for Palestinians. In response, Israel condemned the decision as an act that promotes antisemitism and provides legitimacy to extremist ideologies.
amharic: የእንግሊዝና የዌልስ አረንጓዴ ፓርቲ ጽዮናዊነትን እንደ ዘረኝነት በመፈረጅ ባሳለፈው ውሳኔ እስራኤል ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አሰምታለች። ይህ አዲስ የፓርቲው ፖሊሲ ሁለት መንግስታትን የመፍጠር መፍትሄን በመቃወም፣ ለሁሉም እኩል መብት ያለው አንድ ዲሞክራሲያዊ የፍልስጤም መንግስት እንዲመሰረት ይጠይቃል። እስራኤል ይህንን ውሳኔ የጥላቻ ንግግርን የሚያበረታታ እና የአሸባሪ ቡድኖችን ርዕዮተ ዓለም የሚያራምድ ድርጊት ነው በማለት አውግዛለች።
oromo: Paartiin Magariisaa (Green Party) kan Ingliz fi Weels, Siyonizimiin akka sanyii loogii (racism) ibsuun sagalee isaa erga kenne booda, mootummaan Israa'el mufii guddaa ibsiteetti. Imaammanni kun furmaata biyyoota lamaa (two-state solution) mormuun, biyya tokko kan mirgi lammiilee hundaa keessatti kabajamee jiru hundeessuuf yaada dhiyeessa. Israa'el murtoo kana 'jibbiinsa sanyii' fi 'deeggarsa shororkeessummaa' jechuun balaaleffatteetti.

title: Israel says it killed head of Turkish NGO, Hamas commander in separate Gaza strikes
english: The Israeli military reported the targeted killings of two individuals in Gaza, including the leader of a Turkish humanitarian group named Saqr Nabil Musa Qais. Israel alleged that Qais was connected to Hamas's armed faction, though no specific proof was offered to support this claim. A separate airstrike in the same region resulted in the death of a high-ranking Hamas field commander.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በጋዛ ባደረሰው ጥቃት የቱርክ የሰብአዊ ድርጅት መሪ የሆኑትን ሳቅር ናቢል ሙሳ ቀይስን መግደሉን አስታውቋል። እስራኤል ግለሰቡ ከሃማስ ታጣቂ ቡድን ጋር ግንኙነት ነበራቸው ብላ ብትከስም፣ ለዚህ ማስረጃ ግን አላቀረበችም። በተጨማሪም፣ በተመሳሳይ አካባቢ በተፈጸመ ሌላ የአየር ጥቃት የሃማስ ከፍተኛ አዛዥ መገደሉ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el gaaza keessatti haleellaa geggeesseen hogganaa dhaabbata gargaarsa namoomaa kan Turkiyaa Saqir Naabil Muusaa Qaayis jedhamu ajjeesuu isaa beeksiseera. Israa'el namichi kun garee hidhattoota Hamaas waliin walitti dhufeenya qaba jettee himattus, ragaa gahaa ta'e garuu hin dhiyeessine. Kana malees, naannoo sanatti haleellaa biraatiin ajajaan waraanaa Hamaas tokko ajjeefamuu isaa ibsameera.

title: Explosions reported near tanker off southern Yemen: UKMTO
english: A commercial ship reported multiple explosions near its location in the Gulf of Aden, situated off the coast of Yemen. Fortunately, the crew members are unharmed, and there are no signs of environmental impact from the incident. Authorities are monitoring the situation following the report from the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations.
amharic: አንድ የንግድ መርከብ በየመን የባህር ጠረፍ አቅራቢያ በኤደን ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ በርካታ ፍንዳታዎች እንደታዩ ዘግቧል። እንደ እድል ሆኖ፣ በመርከቡ ላይ የነበሩት ሰራተኞች ደህና ናቸው እንዲሁም በባህር አካባቢ ላይ ምንም አይነት ጉዳት አልደረሰም። የብሪታንያ የባህር ላይ ንግድ ስራዎች ኤጀንሲ ሁኔታውን እየተከታተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Dooniin daldalaa tokko naannoo garba Aden, qarqara biyya Yemenitti, dhukaatii hedduu akka arge gabaaseera. Gammachuu qabaachuu isaatiin, hojjettoonni doonichaa miidhaa malee fayyaa dha; akkasumas naannichatti miidhaan qilleensaafi bishaanii irra gahuu isaa hinfudhatamne. Dhaabbanni daldala bishaan irraa kan Biritish haala kana hordofaa jira.

title: War on Iran: Is escalation more likely than a deal?
english: Former American and Iranian diplomats believe the conflict between the two nations is likely to intensify rather than reach a diplomatic solution. Distrust remains high, as Iran dismisses US claims regarding the motivation behind the confrontation. Experts suggest that instead of relying on American leadership, regional nations may need to take the initiative to manage the ongoing crisis.
amharic: የቀድሞ የአሜሪካ እና የኢራን ዲፕሎማቶች በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግጭት ወደ ሰላማዊ መፍትሄ ከማምራት ይልቅ ይበልጥ እየተባባሰ ሊሄድ እንደሚችል ይስማማሉ። ኢራን በአሜሪካ የይገባኛል ጥያቄዎች ላይ እምነት ስለሌላት በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው አለመተማመን ከፍተኛ ነው። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት፣ ቀውሱን ለመቆጣጠር ከአሜሪካ አመራር ይልቅ በክልሉ የሚገኙ ሀገራት በራሳቸው ተነሳሽነት መፍትሄ መፈለግ እንዳለባቸው ይጠቁማሉ።
oromo: Diplomaatonni duraanii kan Ameerikaa fi Iraan akka amantii isaaniitti walitti bu'iinsi biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru gara furmaata nagaatti cehuu irra, gara caalaatti hammaachuu danda'a. Iraan himannaa Ameerikaa waan hin amanneef, wal amantii dhabuun kun gadi fageenya qaba. Ogeeyyiin akka gorsanitti, rakkoo kana furuuf biyyoonni naannichaa ofiisaanii qajeelfama fudhachuun, hogganummaa Ameerikaa irraa walaba ta'uun furmaata barbaaduun barbaachisaa ta'uu danda'a.

title: Ku Klux Klan leader claims rising support ahead of US midterm elections
english: A leader from the Ku Klux Klan is asserting that the group is gaining more followers as it attempts to change its public image to focus on faith and family. The organization is trying to increase its relevance leading up to the United States midterm elections. Reporters are investigating the actual reach and impact of these claims to determine if the group's influence is truly expanding.
amharic: የኩ ክሉክስ ክላን መሪ ቡድኑ በሃይማኖት እና በቤተሰብ እሴቶች ላይ ለማተኮር እየሞከረ በመሆኑ ተከታዮቹ እየጨመሩ መምጣታቸውን ተናግረዋል። ድርጅቱ በአሜሪካ መካከለኛ ምርጫ ወቅት ተፅዕኖውን ለማሳደግ ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። ጋዜጠኞች ይህ ቡድን በእርግጥ ተፅዕኖ እያሳደገ መሆኑን ወይም የይገባኛል ጥያቄው እውነታ ያለው መሆኑን በመመርመር ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Hogganaan garee Ku Klux Klan jedhamu tokko, gareen isaa amantii fi maatii irratti xiyyeeffachuun akkaataa itti dhiyaatu jijjiirrachaa waan jiruuf deeggarsi isaa dabalaa akka jiru dubbate. Gareen kun filannoo giddu galeessa Ameerikaa dursee dhiibbaa isaa dabaluuf yaalaa jira. Ogeeyyiin oduu gabaasan, himannaan garee kanaa dhugaa ta'uu fi dhiibbaan isaa guddachaa jiraachuu isaa qorachaa jiru.

title: Police investigating Flydubai co-pilot’s Australia ties
english: Australian authorities are investigating Hamam al-Hammami, the Omani co-pilot who allegedly attempted to seize control of a Flydubai flight using an axe. Reports indicate he previously studied in Melbourne, where he reportedly engaged with extremist groups. The incident has prompted Israeli officials to review their aviation security protocols after discovering a loophole that allowed the pilot to fly despite his background.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ ባለስልጣናት ወደ እስራኤል በሚበር አውሮፕላን ላይ መጥረቢያ በመጠቀም የበረራ ቁጥጥርን ለመቆጣጠር የሞከረውን የኦማን ተወላጅ ረዳት አብራሪ ሃማም አል-ሃማሚን ጉዳይ እየመረመሩ ነው። ተጠርጣሪው ከዚህ ቀደም በአውስትራሊያ ሜልቦርን ከተማ በትምህርት ላይ በነበረበት ወቅት ከአክራሪ ቡድኖች ጋር ግንኙነት እንደነበረው ተነግሯል። ይህ ድርጊት የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት የአየር በረራ ደህንነት መቆጣጠሪያዎቻቸውን እንደገና እንዲገመግሙ እና በስርአቱ ውስጥ የነበረውን ክፍተት እንዲያስተካክሉ አስገድዷቸዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Awustiraaliyaa gargaaraa obiraytaraa lammii Omaan kan ta'e Hamam al-Hammami, xiyyaara gara Israa'el deemaa ture irratti cabbii fayyadamuun to'annaa xiyyaarichaa fudhachuuf yaale qorachaa jiru. Gabaasni akka agarsiisutti, namichi kun kanaan dura magaalaa Melbourn, Awustiraaliyaatti barachaa turee fi garee hammaatoo wajjin hidhata akka qabu ibsameera. Haati kun aanga'oota Israa'el sirna nageenya xiyyaaraa isaanii akka fooyyeessan fi gargarummaa kanaan dura ture akka cufan isaan dirqisiiseera.

title: Ukraine ready for US-backed talks with Russia: Zelenskyy
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has announced that his country is prepared to participate in trilateral negotiations with the United States and Russia this month. These potential talks, possibly hosted in the UAE or another location suggested by Washington, aim to find a resolution to the ongoing war. Meanwhile, both nations continue to prepare for increased military attacks, despite the renewed push for a ceasefire.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ አገራቸው በዚህ ወር ከአሜሪካ እና ከሩሲያ ጋር ባለሶስትዮሽ ንግግር ለማድረግ ዝግጁ መሆኗን አስታውቀዋል። በተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ወይም አሜሪካ በምትጠቁመው ሌላ ቦታ ሊካሄድ የሚችለው ይህ ውይይት፣ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን ጦርነት ለመቋጨት ያለመ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ የሁለቱ አገራት የተኩስ አቁም ጥረት እየተደረገ ቢሆንም፣ በሌላ በኩል ሁለቱም ወገኖች ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶቻቸውን ለመቀጠል እየተዘጋጁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukireen Volodimiir Zelenski biyyi isaanii ji'a kana keessa Ameerikaa fi Raashiyaa waliin marii sadanii gochuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru. Mariin kun Emireetota Arabaa Gamtoomaniitti ykn iddoo Ameerikaan filattu biratti kan gaggeeffamu ta'ee, waraana waggoota dheeraaf turerra furmaata argachuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Haa ta'u malee, carraaqqiin waraana dhaabsisuu kun jiruus, gama lameenuu lola caalaatti finiinsuuf qophii taasisaa jiru.

title: Mass protests demanding poll chief resignation shake India for third day
english: For the third consecutive day, thousands of protesters across India have gathered to demand the resignation of Election Commission chief Gyanesh Kumar. Demonstrators allege that the commission intentionally removed millions of eligible voters from electoral rolls to unfairly boost the ruling BJP party's chances. While the election officials deny these claims and maintain that they are simply cleaning up voter records, police have detained numerous protesters to stop the ongoing rallies.
amharic: በህንድ ውስጥ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች የሀገሪቱ የምርጫ ኮሚሽን ሃላፊ የሆኑት ጋያንሽ ኩማር ስልጣናቸውን እንዲለቁ በመጠየቅ ለሶስተኛ ቀን ተቃውሟቸውን ቀጥለዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የምርጫ ኮሚሽኑ ገዢውን የቢጄፒ ፓርቲ ለመጥቀም በሚል በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ብቁ መራጮችን ከምርጫ ዝርዝር ውስጥ ሰርዟል ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። የምርጫ ኮሚሽኑ ክሱ መሰረት የለሽ መሆኑን በመግለጽ የመራጮች ዝርዝር ማሻሻያው ስህተቶችን ለማረም ብቻ የታለመ ነው ቢልም፣ በዋና ከተማዋ ኒው ዴልሂ እና በሙምባይ የተደረጉ ተቃውሞዎች በፖሊስ እስራት ታጅበው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman guyyaa sadaffaaf hiriira ba'uun, itti gaafatamaan komishinii filannoo biyyattii Gyaanesh Kumaar aangoo gadhiisuu qabu jechuun gaafachaa jiru. Hiriirtotni komishinichi paartii bulchaa jiru BJP fayyaduuf jechuun namoota sagalee kennuuf mirga qaban miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman galmee filannoo irraa haqee jira jechuun himatu. Komishinichi himannaa kana kan haale yoo ta'u, jijjiiramni inni godhe maqaa namoota du'anii fi kanneen seeraan ala galmaa'an sirreessuuf qofa akka ta'e ibse; ta'us, hiriirri magaalaa Niiw Deelii fi Mumbai keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru kun poolisiin namoota hedduu hidhuu isaatiin itti fufee jira.

title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
english: Yemen’s internationally recognized government has declared a full-scale military campaign to regain territory currently controlled by Houthi rebels. This announcement follows an intensification of hostilities, including recent Houthi strikes on Saudi oil facilities and the rebels' successful efforts to isolate the key city of Taiz. President Rashad al-Alimi stated that the operation aims to restore state authority across the entire country after a decade of Houthi occupation in the capital.

Labsiin kun kan dhufe, gareen Huthichaa buufataalee boba'aa Sa'udii irratti haleellaa raawwachuun isaa fi magaalaa Ta'izitti karaa gargaarsaa kutuun isaa booda. Preezdaant Raashaad Al-Aliimi akka jedhanitti, kaayyoon waraana kanaa waggoota kurnan dabran harka Huthitti kan jirtu magaalaa Sanaa dabalatee, aangoof hoggansa mootummaa guutuu biyyattii irratti deebisanii dhaabuu dha.

title: Christa Pike's prognosis still unclear after failed execution, lawyer says
english: Convicted murderer Christa Pike remains in critical condition and is on a ventilator after a failed execution attempt in Tennessee. Her lawyer stated that it is still unclear if she will recover, as doctors work to remove lethal drugs from her system. Following the incident, the state governor has paused all future executions for the year, while officials have yet to explain the failure or announce next steps.

oromo: Kristaa Paayik, dubartii ajjeechaa raawwattee du'atti murteeffamee turte, yaalii ajjeechaa irratti godhame booda haalli fayyaa ishee yaaddessaa ta'ee mana yaalaa jirti.
